title: Resolve compiled components and nets to schematic objects
summary: Bridges the compiled project data model to the live schematic objects with DM_SchHandle and SupportsInterface, to list vault components and recolour the wires and buses of a net.
phrasings: get the schematic object behind a compiled component
change the colour of all wires on a net
find components placed from a workspace vault
highlight a bus net on every sheet

commands.name: ListVaultComponents
commands.description: List the vault components of the focused project via their schematic objects
commands.params: Project=<file name or path> (optional, default the focused project)|All=true (optional: also list components without a VaultGUID)

commands.name: RecolorNetObjects
commands.description: Recolour the schematic wires and buses of a compiled net
commands.params: Net=<net name> (required)|Color=<BGR: decimal, 0x or # hex> (default 0x0000FF, red)|Project=<file name or path> (optional)
